title: Low-Discrepancy Dither for Quantized Recurrent State Caches
abstract: arXiv:2609.39185v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mamba-style and hybrid language models compress their past into a fixed-size recurrent state that is rewritten at every generated token. Storing this state in low precision saves memory bandwidth, but every rounding error is fed back into the next update and can accumulate over long generations. Production systems round the state stochastically; we ask which rounding rule such caches should use. We find that a deterministic golden-ratio Weyl dither, which needs no random numbers, consistently brings the quantized model closer to the full-precision one than stochastic rounding, across pure and hybrid models, storage formats, and long decoding horizons, at no extra cost. Round-to-nearest behaves differently: because it discards small updates, its error keeps growing, so it can look best in short evaluations yet falls far behind over long generations. translated_title: 用于量化循环状态缓存的低差异性抖动
translated_abstract: Mamba风格和混合语言模型将其历史信息压缩到一个固定大小的循环状态中，该状态在每个生成的token时都会被重写。以低精度存储该状态可以节省内存带宽，但每一次舍入误差都会被反馈到下一次更新中，并可能在长文本生成过程中不断累积。生产系统目前采用随机舍入的方式对该状态进行处理；我们探讨此类缓存究竟应该使用哪种舍入规则。我们发现，一种无需随机数的确定性黄金比例Weyl抖动方法，在纯模型和混合模型、各种存储格式以及长解码场景下，都能始终比随机舍入更好地使量化模型接近全精度模型，且不产生任何额外开销。最近舍入的行为则截然不同：由于它会丢弃微小的更新，其误差会持续增长，因此在短期评估中可能表现最佳，但在长文本生成中则远远落后。一项差异性分析解释了这种优劣排序，此外我们还记录了实现过程中的种种陷阱。
tldr: 提出一种无需随机数的确定性黄金比例Weyl抖动方法，用于量化循环状态缓存的舍入操作，在长文本生成中始终比随机舍入更接近全精度模型且无额外开销。
en_tdlr: A deterministic golden-ratio Weyl dither requiring no random numbers consistently brings quantized recurrent state caches closer to full-precision models than stochastic rounding across long generation horizons, at no extra cost.
